photos.name: img-7787-prep-1224
photos.summary: Shape stage: rolled dough round on a silicone mat, sized close to the 11 in target diameter. Wooden rolling pin, bench scraper, and a bowl of walnut-currant filling sit nearby on the counter.

photos.name: img-7789-oven-1331
photos.summary: Bake stage: 16 baked rugelach crescents on parchment-lined sheet pan, golden brown with sugared tops. Visible filling leakage and small caramelized puddles at the seams between cookies.

photos.name: img-7790-finished-1357
photos.summary: Six clear gift bags of finished rugelach arranged on a kitchen counter, each holding a few cooled crescents portioned for sharing.
